recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（CD3 對 CD52，淋巴球閘門），非形態影像；大量藍色族群為 CD3 陽性且 CD52 表現，旁邊有 CD3 稍弱的綠色族群與 CD3 陰性的洋紅色族群，CD52 表現與 T-PLL 使用 alemtuzumab 治療有關。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD3-PC5.5 (x-axis) versus CD52-PE (y-axis), gated on [Lymphs]
Dense dominant blue population with CD3 expression (about 10^2) and CD52 expression spanning roughly 10^0 to 10^1
Adjacent green CD3-positive population with slightly dimmer CD3 and similar or slightly brighter CD52
Magenta CD3-negative population with CD52 expression, representing non-T lymphocytes
Few scattered red events near the CD3-positive clusters
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the lymphocyte gate displays CD3 versus CD52 expression. A large, dominant CD3-positive population (blue) expresses CD52, alongside a smaller CD3-positive population with slightly dimmer CD3 (green) and a CD3-negative, CD52-positive population (magenta). Colour assignment and quantitative intensity reference are not provided, so relative CD52 brightness of the neoplastic cells cannot be judged precisely from this plot alone. The expansion of a CD52-expressing CD3-positive population is consistent with the given diagnosis of T-prolymphocytic leukemia, in which CD52 expression supports alemtuzumab-based therapy.
